WITH target AS ( SELECT medication_id FROM tb_stock_requirement WHERE ship_id = #{shipId} UNION SELECT medication_id FROM tb_stock_lot WHERE ship_id = #{shipId} )
SELECT m.id AS medication_id, m.name AS medication_name, m.unit AS unit, COALESCE(SUM(l.remaining_quantity), 0)::INT AS available, (r.id IS NOT NULL) AS requirement_set, r.min_quantity AS min_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(l.remaining_quantity), 0) < r.min_quantity AS shortage FROM target t JOIN tb_medication m ON m.id = t.medication_id LEFT JOIN tb_stock_requirement r ON r.ship_id = #{shipId} AND r.medication_id = t.medication_id LEFT JOIN tb_stock_lot l ON l.ship_id = #{shipId} AND l.medication_id = t.medication_id AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.expiry_date >= #{today} AND l.remaining_quantity > 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.unit, r.id, r.min_quantity ORDER BY m.id

SELECT l.medication_id AS medication_id, l.id AS lot_id, l.remaining_quantity AS quantity, l.expiry_date AS expiry_date FROM tb_stock_lot l WHERE l.ship_id = #{shipId} AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.remaining_quantity > 0 AND l.expiry_date >= #{today} AND l.expiry_date <= #{expiringUntil} ORDER BY l.medication_id, l.expiry_date, l.received_at, l.id
